html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Contact

Quest Description: Talk to Agent Hammer on Level 1 of Algernon

Quest Reward: 1750 gold

Return to: Agent Hammer

Repeatable: No

Followed by:

Tax Evasive Actions (2)

Quest Giver: Agent Hammer

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect MORE receipts from creatures in Algernon.

Quest Reward: 875 gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: ?

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go and speak to Agent Hammer on Level 1 of Algernon about finding some more receipts. Good job.

Offer:

From the sounds of it, the King's Board of Trustees is none too happy with the result of the Audit. They aren't satisfied that the Receipts you collected from the creatures in Algernon represent their true losses. Good work getting their khakis all in a ruffle.

Well, you have some work cut out for you now. So we are going to deputize you. Congratulations.

Now that the celebration is over, the Board members are going to want lots more Receipts. Go talk to Agent Hammer on Level 1 of Algernon and let him know you are helping us with the Audit. Agent Hammer has been working on a way to take down Capwn, maybe this will help.

Now scoot, I need to get some Smekler Powder for this cough.

Turn-in:

Wait, what happened? You know you are probably going to have to repeat yourself shortly.

Client level range: 7–20
